question: धान की नर्सरी में बीज उपचार के लिए कार्बेंडाजिम की कितनी मात्रा प्रयोग करें
question_en: How much carbendazim should be used for seed treatment in a paddy nursery?
answer_en: For seed treatment, use 2 grams of carbendazim per kilogram of seed. The treated seeds should be drained after soaking for 10 hours. Safety: use only pesticides that have an approved label claim for this crop, at the label dose. Wear gloves, a mask and full clothing while spraying, do not spray against the wind, and keep chemicals away from children, food and water sources.
answer: बीज उपचार के लिए, 2 ग्राम कार्बेंडाज़िम प्रति किलोग्राम बीज का उपयोग करें। उपचारित बीजों को 10 घंटे तक भिगोने के बाद छानना चाहिए। सुरक्षाः लेबल खुराक पर केवल उन कीटनाशकों का उपयोग करें जिनके पास इस फसल के लिए एक अनुमोदित लेबल दावा है। छिड़काव करते समय दस्ताने, मास्क और पूरे कपड़े पहनें, हवा के खिलाफ छिड़काव न करें, और रसायनों को बच्चों, भोजन और पानी के स्रोतों से दूर रखें।

retrieved.title: Rice wet nursery and seed treatment (transplanted puddled lowland rice)
retrieved.text: Soak the seed in a solution of carbendazim, pyroquilon or tricyclazole at 2 g per litre of water for every 1 kg of seed. Soak for 10 hours and then drain the water. This wet seed treatment protects the seedlings from blast and other seedling diseases for up to 40 days and is better than dry seed treatment. If the seed is to be sown immediately, keep the soaked seed in a gunny bag in the dark, covered, for 24 hours so that it sprouts.

retrieved.title: Ragi (finger millet) crop production
retrieved.text: A nursery of 12.5 cents (500 square metres) is enough for one hectare. Mix 37.5 kg superphosphate with 500 kg farmyard manure and spread it. Make raised beds of 3 m x 1.5 m. Treat seed with Azospirillum and phosphobacteria (600 g each per hectare) or Azophos (1200 g), and with Thiram 4 g, Captan 4 g or Carbendazim 2 g per kg of seed. Broadcast 5 kg of treated seed in shallow rills not deeper than 1 cm. Seedlings are pulled on days 17 to 20.

retrieved.title: Rice wet nursery and seed treatment (transplanted puddled lowland rice)
retrieved.text: Bacillus subtilis (talc formulation) can be used at 10 g per kg of seed, soaked overnight in 1 litre of water; decant the water, allow sprouting for 24 hours and then sow. Biofertilizers can be used as seed soak: Azospirillum 3 packets (600 g/ha) plus phosphobacteria 3 packets (600 g/ha), or Azophos 6 packets (1200 g/ha), mixed in water and used to soak the seed overnight. Biocontrol agents are compatible with biofertilizers and both can be mixed for soaking, but fungicides and biocontrol agents are not compatible and should not be mixed.

question_en: In PM Kisan Yojana, how much money does the farmer's family get in a year?

retrieved.text: PM-KISAN is a Central Sector Scheme that gives income support to landholding farmer families. question: समय पर बोए गए सिंचित गेहूं के लिए नाइट्रोजन फॉस्फोरस और पोटाश की कितनी मात्रा चाहिए
question_en: What is the amount of nitrogen phosphorus and potash required for timely sown irrigated wheat?
answer_en: For timely sown irrigated wheat, the recommended amounts are 120 kg nitrogen, 70 kg phosphorus, and 35 kg potassium per hectare.
answer: समय पर बोए गए सिंचित गेहूं के लिए, अनुशंसित मात्रा 120 कि. ग्रा. नाइट्रोजन, 70 कि. ग्रा. फॉस्फोरस और 35 कि. ग्रा. पोटेशियम प्रति हेक्टेयर है।

retrieved.title: Improved wheat cultivation practices for Central India
retrieved.text: Apply nitrogen, phosphorus and potash in a 4:2:1 ratio along with 10 tonnes of farmyard manure per hectare. - Restricted irrigation: 80:40:20 (urea 180 kg, SSP 250 kg, MOP 30 kg). - Timely sown irrigated bread wheat: 120:60:30 (urea 260 kg, SSP 375 kg, MOP 50 kg). - Durum wheat: 140:70:35 (urea 300 kg, SSP 440 kg, MOP 60 kg). - Late sown: 100:50:25 (urea 220 kg, SSP 310 kg, MOP 42 kg).

retrieved.title: Converting N-P-K recommendations into urea, SSP and MOP quantities
retrieved.section: Worked example: timely sown irrigated wheat (120:60:30 per hectare)
retrieved.text: Urea = 120 x 100 / 46 = about 260 kg; SSP = 60 x 100 / 16 = 375 kg; MOP = 30 x 100 / 60 = 50 kg per hectare. These match the published table for wheat (urea 260 kg, SSP 375 kg, MOP 50 kg).

retrieved.title: Improved wheat cultivation practices for Central India
retrieved.section: Sowing time and number of irrigations
retrieved.text: - Timely sown with restricted irrigation: 20 October to 10 November, 1 to 2 irrigations. - Timely sown irrigated: 10 to 25 November, 3 to 5 irrigations. - Late sown irrigated: 1 December to 5 January, 4 to 5 irrigations. Varieties recommended for the zone include HI 1500 (Amrita), HI 1544 (Purna) and HI 1633 (Pusa Vani).

question: कपास में गुलाबी सुंडी के लिए नीम का छिड़काव कब करना चाहिए
question_en: When to spray neem for pink sundi in cotton
answer_en: Spray neem seed kernel extract 5% plus neem oil 50 ml plus detergent or soap 10 g in 10 litres of water at 50 to 60 days after sowing. Safety: use only pesticides that have an approved label claim for this crop, at the label dose. Wear gloves, a mask and full clothing while spraying, do not spray against the wind, and keep chemicals away from children, food and water sources.
answer: बुवाई के 50 से 60 दिनों बाद 10 लीटर पानी में नीम के बीज की गुठली का अर्क 5 प्रतिशत और नीम का तेल 50 मिली और डिटर्जेंट या साबुन 10 ग्राम का छिड़काव करें। सुरक्षाः लेबल खुराक पर केवल उन कीटनाशकों का उपयोग करें जिनके पास इस फसल के लिए एक अनुमोदित लेबल दावा है। छिड़काव करते समय दस्ताने, मास्क और पूरे कपड़े पहनें, हवा के खिलाफ छिड़काव न करें, और रसायनों को बच्चों, भोजन और पानी के स्रोतों से दूर रखें।

retrieved.title: Pink bollworm management in cotton
retrieved.text: Spray neem seed kernel extract 5% plus neem oil 50 ml plus detergent or soap 10 g in 10 litres of water at 50 to 60 days after sowing. Release Trichogramma bactrae egg parasitoids at 60,000 per acre, three times at weekly intervals, between 90 and 120 days after sowing, and avoid insecticide sprays for at least 10 days after each release.

retrieved.title: Pink bollworm management in cotton
retrieved.text: Spray only when the pest crosses the ETL. Avoid synthetic pyrethroids before November and never use insecticide mixtures or tank mixes, because they cause whitefly and aphid outbreaks. Do not use extremely hazardous (red triangle) or highly hazardous (yellow triangle) insecticides, which kill beneficial insects. Always follow label claims.

question: टमाटर में पत्ती मोड़क रोग किस कीट से फैलता है
question_en: Which insect is responsible for the spread of leaf-worm disease in tomatoes?
answer_en: The whitefly (Bemisia tabaci) is the main insect responsible for spreading leaf-worm disease in tomatoes. Note: part of this answer could not be verified against my sources; please confirm it with your nearest KVK or the Kisan Call Centre (1800-180-1551).
answer: सफेद मक्खी (बेमिसिया तबासी) मुख्य कीट है जो टमाटर में पत्ती-कीड़े की बीमारी फैलाने के लिए जिम्मेदार है। नोटः इस उत्तर के कुछ हिस्से को मेरे स्रोतों के खिलाफ सत्यापित नहीं किया जा सका; कृपया अपने निकटतम केवीके या किसान कॉल सेंटर (1800-180-1551) से इसकी पुष्टि करें।

retrieved.title: Major diseases of tomato and their management
retrieved.text: Plants are severely stunted, leaves roll downward and crinkle, older leaves become leathery and plants look bushy. The virus is spread mainly by the whitefly Bemisia tabaci. Raise the nursery under protection (insect-proof net), grow sorghum, maize or bajra as barrier crops, use disease-free seedlings, install yellow sticky traps at 5 per acre and remove the weed host Abutilon indicum. To control whitefly, spray one of dimethoate 30 EC 200 ml per acre, thiamethoxam 25 WG 200 g per acre or imidacloprid 17.8 SL 200 ml per acre.

retrieved.title: Major diseases of tomato and their management
retrieved.text: Water-soaked black lesions appear on leaves and stems and expand quickly; white growth may appear on leaves, and fruits get dark brown lesions with soft rot. It is favoured by cool nights, warm days and long wet periods from rain or fog; the optimum temperature for sporulation is 18-22 C. Provide proper drainage and rotate crops. Apply Trichoderma asperellum to soil at 1.0 kg per acre. Sprays include cyazofamid 34.5% SC 80 ml per acre or azoxystrobin 23% SC 200 ml per acre.

retrieved.title: Major diseases of tomato and their management
retrieved.text: Leaves show brown spots with concentric rings (a bull's-eye pattern) and yellow margins; fruits get infected near the calyx with brown concentric rings. It is favoured by warm, humid weather (24-29 C) and rain. The fungus survives in crop debris and on seed, and spreads by rain and wind. Remove and destroy crop debris, rotate crops and treat seed with Trichoderma asperellum 4 g per kg. Sprays include azoxystrobin 23% SC 200 ml per acre, mancozeb 35% SC 1 kg per acre or zineb 75% WP 800 g per acre.

question: मृदा स्वास्थ्य कार्ड में मिट्टी के कितने मापदंड जांचे जाते हैं
question_en: How many soil parameters are checked in a soil health card?
answer_en: A soil health card checks 12 parameters, including macronutrients (nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium), secondary nutrients (sulphur), micronutrients (zinc, iron, copper, manganese, boron), and physical parameters like pH, EC, and organic carbon.
answer: एक मृदा स्वास्थ्य कार्ड 12 मापदंडों की जांच करता है, जिसमें मैक्रोन्यूट्रिएंट्स (नाइट्रोजन, फॉस्फोरस, पोटेशियम), द्वितीयक पोषक तत्व (सल्फर), सूक्ष्म पोषक तत्व (जस्ता, लोहा, तांबा, मैंगनीज, बोरॉन) और भौतिक मापदंड जैसे पीएच, ईसी और कार्बनिक कार्बन शामिल हैं।

retrieved.title: Soil Health Card scheme
retrieved.text: The soil sample is analysed for 12 parameters: - Macronutrients: nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P), potassium (K); - Secondary nutrient: sulphur (S); - Micronutrients: zinc (Zn), iron (Fe), copper (Cu), manganese (Mn), boron (B); - Physical parameters: pH, electrical conductivity (EC) and organic carbon (OC). Based on these results the card advises which fertilizers to use and in what quantity.

retrieved.title: Soil Health Card scheme
retrieved.section: How a farmer gets the card
retrieved.text: Soil samples are collected from the farm by the state agriculture department and tested in soil testing laboratories. A printed card is given for each holding. The scheme's objectives mention issuing cards every two years, while the factsheet's key features mention once every three years, so the farmer should check the current cycle with the local agriculture office. Details are available on the portal soilhealth.dac.gov.in.

retrieved.title: Soil Health Card scheme
retrieved.text: A National Productivity Council study (2017) found that chemical fertilizer use fell by 8-10% and crop yields rose by 5-6% after farmers followed soil health card recommendations. About 10.7 crore cards were issued in cycle I (2015-17) and 11.97 crore in cycle II (2017-19).

question: फसल बीमा योजना में फसल नुकसान की सूचना कितने घंटे के अंदर देनी होती है
question_en: Crop insurance plans require crop loss to be reported within how many hours.
answer_en: Crop insurance plans require crop loss to be reported within 72 hours of the event. Earlier, this was set at 48 hours.
answer: फसल बीमा योजनाओं में फसल के नुकसान की सूचना घटना के 72 घंटों के भीतर देने की आवश्यकता होती है। इससे पहले यह 48 घंटे निर्धारित किया गया था।

retrieved.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) crop insurance
retrieved.text: For localized calamities and post-harvest losses, the farmer must inform the loss within 72 hours of the event (earlier it was 48 hours). The loss can be reported to the insurance company's local office, the bank, the state agriculture department, the crop insurance web portal or app, or the toll-free number. For area-wide losses assessed through crop-cutting yield data at the end of the season, the farmer does not need to inform individually.

retrieved.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) crop insurance
retrieved.text: The scheme covers crop loss from pre-sowing to post-harvest. Localized risks covered include hailstorm, landslide, inundation, cloud burst and natural fire. Post-harvest losses caused by cyclone, cyclonic or unseasonal rain and hailstorm are covered for up to 14 days after harvest, when the crop is kept in the field to dry. Damage by wild animals is an optional add-on that a state may choose to offer at its own cost.

retrieved.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) crop insurance
retrieved.text: If the insurance company delays settlement beyond two months of the cut-off date, it must pay 12% interest to the farmer.

question: किसान क्रेडिट कार्ड का कर्ज़ समय पर चुकाने पर ब्याज दर कितनी लगती है
question_en: What is the interest rate on timely repayment of Kisan Credit Card loan?

retrieved.text: Under the Modified Interest Subvention Scheme (MISS), short-term crop loans up to Rs 3 lakh through KCC are given at a concessional interest rate of 7% per year. retrieved.title: Vermicompost production and use
retrieved.text: 1. Mix cow dung and chopped dry leaves in a 3:1 ratio and let it partly decompose for 15 to 20 days. 2. Lay a 15-20 cm layer of chopped dry leaves or grass at the bottom of the bed. 3. Fill the bed (6 x 2 x 2 feet) with 1.5 to 2.0 quintals of partly decomposed material. 4. Release 1,500 to 2,000 red earthworms on the upper layer. 5. Sprinkle water immediately and keep the bed moist by daily sprinkling; cover with gunny bags or polythene. 6. Turn the material once after 30 days for aeration. 7. The compost is ready in 45 to 50 days; output is about three-quarters of the raw material weight.
